Overview

Hong Kong is a city in HK with a population of 7,498,000. A dynamic global financial center where East meets West, known for its iconic skyline, bustling harbor, and world-class shopping and dining. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
